title: Check if Numbers Are Ascending in a Sentence
goal: Check whether numbers appear in strictly increasing order within a sentence.
strategy: Ignore word tokens and compare each numeric token with the previous number. Equality is a failure because the required ordering is strict.

phasePurposes.start: Check whether numbers appear in strictly increasing order within a sentence.
phasePurposes.inspect: Ignore word tokens and compare each numeric token with the previous number. Equality is a failure because the required ordering is strict.
phasePurposes.update: Ignore word tokens and compare each numeric token with the previous number. Equality is a failure because the required ordering is strict.
phasePurposes.done: Check whether numbers appear in strictly increasing order within a sentence.

edgeCases: An equal number breaks strict ordering
A later smaller number is invalid
Only one number needs no comparison
